Scope expanded beyond FemTech to include broader women's health (breast health, maternal care, gynecological surgery, reproductive diagnostics, precision medicine) and European market

EUR-denominated deal values converted to USD at approximate rate at time of deal close

Dataset expanded to include medtech acquirers (Medtronic, Boston Scientific, Coloplast), genomics (Illumina, Myriad, Natera), pharma (Sumitovant/Sumitomo, Organon), and PE (Astorg) — all verified against SEC filings, press releases, and investor relations pages

Hologic acquisition history now spans 7 deals (Biotheranostics, Endomagnetics, Gynesonics, Acessa Health, Bolder Surgical, Focal Therapeutics, Faxitron Bioptics, SuperSonic Imagine) — largest disclosed women's health serial acquirer in dataset

Dataset v5 expands to 58 acquisitions with menopause therapeutics (Bayer/KaNDy, Astellas/Ogeda), large-cap diagnostics (Hologic/Gen-Probe $3.7B), global fertility clinic consolidation (KKR/IVI-RMA $3.25B, BPEA EQT/Indira IVF $657M, IVI-RMA/Eugin NA), and women's health-focused acquirer expansions (Organon/Dermavant $1.2B, Hims & Hers/Apostrophe)
